svg.title: Five sources, one graph
svg.desc: MIBiG, PubChem, NCBI Taxonomy, KEGG and the curated bridge, in the order they run, with what each needs first, its licence, and the node and edge types it adds.
svg.text: They run in this order, because each one builds on what the ones above it wrote. Every licence is recorded.
